description: Provider-free agent process used to validate planned/auditable orchestration without an external AI provider.
goal: Classify an incoming case, identify required follow-up work, and return a planned orchestration decision.
instructions: Use the provided case context to produce a deterministic triage plan. This fixture intentionally omits provider config so the backend records a planned agent execution.
constraints: Route high-risk cases to human review.
memoryPolicy: Persist input context, decision, reason, and planned next actions.

steps.title: Classify case
steps.description: Inspect amount, priority, and request title to classify the case.
steps.reasoning: Classification determines whether human review is required.

steps.title: Prepare follow-up plan
steps.description: Create an auditable list of next actions for the process.
steps.reasoning: Provider-free orchestration still needs a traceable decision artifact.
